requirement: Getting started: × closes as Skip; Hide from account menu records the per-account flag (since #1216 the screen stays open); the row leaves the account menu and Help still reopens the screen

oracle.invariant: × closes the screen as dismissed, leads nowhere and leaves the menu flag untouched. Hide posts to /api/onboarding/menu-hide with the session cookie; since #1216 it no longer closes the screen (the button turns into Show in account menu, REG-PR-1216-getting-started-menu-show); a refused door (403) or no network never throws and never hangs the screen. The desktop surface takes the close from the device and the menu flag from the account; hideMenu goes to the account door. GET /api/onboarding answers {completedAt, menuHiddenAt}; the first menu-hide wins; 401 without a session.
